movie.title: Here the Whole Time

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: When his neighbor and long-time crush unexpectedly moves into his house for two weeks, an insecure teenager sees his quiet vacation transform into an emotional roller coaster of unresolved feelings.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Felipe's dream of a quiet, relaxing school break filled with epic series marathons is shattered when his neighbor and secret crush, Caio, comes to stay at his house for fifteen days. As the two spend unprecedented time together in close quarters, Felipe is forced to confront his deep-seated insecurities and hidden romantic desires. Over the course of two chaotic weeks, their daily interactions unleash a whirlwind of long-suppressed emotions. Ultimately, what began as an unwelcome intrusion becomes a transformative journey of self-acceptance and unexpected connection.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Felipe is a sensitive and body-insecure teenager looking forward to spending his school vacation isolated at home, indulging in endless TV marathons and peace. His plans are completely upended when his mother announces that Caio, a handsome neighbor and classmate on whom Felipe has harbored a secret crush, will be staying in his guest room for two weeks while his parents are away. Initially overcome with anxiety and self-consciousness, Felipe tries to maintain his distance to protect his vulnerable heart. However, sharing a living space inevitably forces the two boys into close proximity, leading to shared late-night conversations, shared meals, and moments of surprising emotional intimacy. As Caio opens up about his own struggles and pressure, Felipe begins to see past the polished exterior of his crush. The initial awkwardness gradually transforms into a deep bond, igniting a whirlwind of unspoken feelings and resolving long-standing misunderstandings between them. Navigating the delicate boundary between friendship and romance, Felipe learns to embrace his true self and overcome his insecurities. By the time the two weeks come to an end, both boys are irrevocably changed, having built a foundation of genuine affection and emotional maturity that reshapes their future.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: An endearing coming-of-age story that explores the tender complexity of adolescent love, self-image, and emotional vulnerability. When an insecure teenager's quiet vacation is interrupted by the surprise arrival of his neighbor and crush as a houseguest for two weeks, he is thrust into a close-quarters situation he feels entirely unprepared for. Through a blend of humor, drama, and heartfelt romance, the story captures the transformative power of being truly seen by someone else, turning an unexpected cohabitation into an unforgettable journey of personal growth and romance.

story_structure.climax: Tensions and unspoken emotions reach a peak as the two weeks draw to a close, forcing Felipe to directly confront his deepest self-doubts and declare his true feelings before time runs out.
story_structure.conflict: His quiet getaway is upended when Caio, his neighbor and longtime crush, arrives to stay at his home for two full weeks, forcing Felipe to navigate his intense insecurities in close quarters.
story_structure.resolution: Felipe emerges with a transformed sense of self-acceptance, having confronted his fears and reshaped his understanding of connection, body image, and love.
story_structure.introduction: Felipe, an insecure teenager, prepares to spend his school vacation relaxing at home with plans for uninterrupted peace, solitude, and series marathons.
story_structure.risingAction: Over the course of fourteen days, forced proximity pushes Felipe out of his comfort zone as shared moments and emotional vulnerability bring his buried feelings and personal struggles to the surface.
